subject: Fail to convert CDF to binary

messages.author: 565c171c4685f44b
messages.subject: Fail to convert CDF to binary
parts:
Dear list,

I have an ASCII Rhesus CDF file

> cdf <- AffymetrixCdfFile$fromChipType("Rhesus")
> cdf
AffymetrixCdfFile:
Path: annotationData/chipTypes/Rhesus
Filename: Rhesus.cdf
Filesize: 116.58MB
File format: v3 (text; ASCII)
Chip type: Rhesus
Dimension: 1164x1164
Number of cells: 1354896
Number of units: 52865
Cells per unit: 25.63
Number of QC units: 9
RAM: 0.00MB

and have tried to convert it using convertCDF() and the example
provided in the help page, but this gave me the following error

(I have changed my working directory to where the original Rhesus.cdf
file is and then typed)

> chipType <- "Rhesus"
> cdfFiles <- findCdf(chipType, firstOnly=FALSE)
> cdfFiles <- list(
+ ASCII=grep("ASCII", cdfFiles, value=TRUE),
+ XDA=grep("XDA", cdfFiles, value=TRUE)
+ )
> outFile <- file.path(tempdir(), sprintf("%s.cdf", chipType))
> convertCdf(cdfFiles$ASCII, outFile, version = "4", verbose=TRUE)
Error in if (!file.exists(filename)) { : argument is of length zero


Where am I going wrong?

Thanks,

David

parts:
FYI,

convertCdf() is part of affxparser and can be used independently of
aroma.affymetrix and its setup. Also, as the message footer below
indicate, traceback() give you useful further information on where the
error occurred. See also the R docs on how to troubleshoot errors.

Cheers

Henrik
